decks.notes: The key focus of this Dimir Control deck is to disrupt and control the opponent's game plan through a combination of hand disruption, counterspells, removal spells, and powerful creatures. The deck aims to maintain control of the board and outvalue the opponent through efficient card advantage and removal. By using a mix of control elements such as Force of Negation, Counterspell, Thoughtseize, Fatal Push, and Subtlety, the deck aims to control the game tempo and win through incremental advantage until it can close out the game with powerful finishers like Murktide Regent and Kaito, Bane of Nightmares.

The deck focuses on aggressive gameplay with efficient and powerful creatures that can quickly control the board and pressure the opponent. It utilizes cards like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer, Scion of Draco, and Territorial Kavu to apply early pressure and close out games quickly. The deck also includes removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Fatal Push to deal with the opponent's threats while protecting its own creatures with cards like Stubborn Denial. Leyline of the Guildpact and Leyline Binding help to boost the deck's creature power and resilience.

The deck revolves around assembling a variety of creature combinations to generate powerful synergies and win the game through a versatile toolbox approach. By utilizing creatures like Devoted Druid and Vizier of Remedies to generate infinite mana or Craterhoof Behemoth for a massive finish, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents with its creature-based combo potential. Green Sun's Zenith and Leyline of Abundance help find and support key pieces, while Nature's Rhythm and Tyvar, Jubilant Brawler provide additional value and disruption in executing the combo strategy effectively.

This deck focuses on using Eldrazi creatures and ramp spells to control the game and overwhelm the opponent with powerful threats. The key strategy is to accelerate mana production using Eldrazi Temple and ramp spells like Utopia Sprawl, allowing for early plays of big threats like Emrakul, the Promised End and Ugin, the Eye of the Storms. Control elements such as Dismember and Kozilek's Command help to disrupt the opponent's plan while maintaining board presence. The deck aims to outvalue the opponent through efficient use of resources and powerful Eldrazi creatures.

The main concept of this Boros Aggro deck is to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures and burn spells. It aims to put pressure on the opponent early on, utilizing cards like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Guide of Souls to quickly chip away at their life total. The deck also includes versatile cards like Seasoned Pyromancer and Ranger-Captain of Eos to generate card advantage and provide additional threats. The inclusion of cards like Galvanic Discharge and Goblin Bombardment allows the deck to close out games quickly with direct damage, making it a potent aggressive force in the Modern format.

The deck focuses on reanimating powerful creatures from the graveyard by cycling through cards and creating a mass reanimation effect with Living End. The key strategy is to fill the graveyard with powerful creatures like Colossal Skyturtle and Oliphaunt, then use cards like Violent Outburst to cast Living End and bring those creatures back. Generous Ent and Shardless Agent help to cycle through the deck quickly, while Force of Negation provides protection. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with a board full of powerful creatures and win through a combo finish.

The main focus of this UW Control deck is to maintain control of the game through counterspells, removal, and powerful planeswalkers like Teferi, Hero of Dominaria and Narset, Parter of Veils. The deck also includes ways to draw cards, such as Orim's Chant and Meticulous Archive, as well as win conditions like Hall of Storm Giants and Solitude. By controlling the board and disrupting the opponent's strategy, this deck aims to outlast and outmaneuver the opponent until victory is achieved.

The main idea of this deck is to control the game by using powerful Eldrazi creatures and planeswalkers like Karn, the Great Creator and Ugin, the Eye of the Storms. By assembling the UrzaTron lands, the deck aims to generate a lot of mana quickly to play high-cost threats like Emrakul, the Promised End. With access to cards like Thought-Knot Seer and Chalice of the Void, the deck can disrupt opponents' strategies while maintaining board control. Overall, the goal is to overwhelm the opponent with efficient threats and powerful disruption spells.

The main concept of this deck is to utilize instant reanimation spells like Goryo's Vengeance to quickly bring powerful creatures like Griselbrand back from the graveyard, while also disrupting the opponent's game plan with cards like Thoughtseize and Force of Negation. The deck also includes cards like Solitude and Ephemerate to deal with opposing threats efficiently. Quantum Riddler and Psychic Frog provide card draw and selection to help find key combo pieces. The deck aims to control the game early on and then quickly close out the game with a powerful reanimated threat.

The deck focuses on quickly generating artifact tokens and utilizing them to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive plays. It combines artifact synergy with aggressive creatures and versatile spells to quickly build a threatening board presence. The key strategy is to use cards like Urza's Saga and Weapons Manufacturing to create artifact tokens, while also using cards like Metallic Rebuke and Engineered Explosives to control the board and protect your key threats. The goal is to quickly build a powerful army of artifacts and overwhelm the opponent before they can establish their own game plan.

This deck focuses on quickly setting up the combo of using Goryo's Vengeance to reanimate Griselbrand or Atraxa, Grand Unifier from the graveyard, allowing for powerful plays. The deck also includes cards like Psychic Frog and Quantum Riddler to filter through the deck and find key pieces. Cards like Solitude and Thoughtseize provide disruption against opponents, while Faithful Mending and Ephemerate help to dig deeper into the deck and provide protection. Overall, the deck aims to quickly assemble its combo pieces and overwhelm the opponent with powerful reanimated creatures.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly cycle through your cards and get your combo pieces onto the battlefield. By using cards like Street Wraith, Curator of Mysteries, and Shardless Agent to cycle through your deck, you can quickly assemble the combo of Living End and Violent Outburst to bring all of your powerful creatures back onto the battlefield from your graveyard. The deck also includes disruption in the form of Force of Negation and Subtlety to protect your combo and disrupt your opponent's game plan. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm your opponent with a powerful board presence and efficient combos.

The deck revolves around utilizing artifacts and legendary creatures like Emry and Tamiyo to create a powerful combo engine. By constantly recurring artifacts like Mishra's Bauble and Grinding Station, the deck aims to generate value and eventually win the game by either milling the opponent out or through a combo involving cards like Loki and Cori-Steel Cutter. The mana base is focused on providing the right colors for the spells while also supporting the Urza's Saga land based engine. The deck aims to create a synergistic and versatile strategy that can adapt to different matchups.

The deck focuses on using various reanimation spells and creatures to quickly put powerful threats onto the battlefield, while also utilizing control elements and card advantage to disrupt opponents' gameplans. Key cards include Solitude, Archon of Cruelty, and Faithful Mending to quickly close out games. The deck also features a mix of removal spells like Prismatic Ending and disruption spells like Thoughtseize to handle opposing threats. With a combination of graveyard manipulation, card draw, and powerful creatures, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents before they can establish a strong board presence.

The deck focuses on aggressive gameplay using the Simic Birthing Ritual mechanic to ramp up quickly and overwhelm opponents with powerful creatures like Abhorrent Oculus and Ice-Fang Coatl. It also includes cards like Misty Rainforest and Verdant Catacombs to ensure consistent mana fixing and access to key cards. Additionally, cards like Flare of Denial and Force of Negation provide control elements to protect your board state. Overall, the deck aims to establish early dominance and maintain pressure throughout the game to secure victory.

The main focus of this Boros Aggro deck is to quickly assemble a board presence and overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures and direct damage spells. Cards like Goblin Bombardment and Guide of Souls help to chip away at the opponent's life total while Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Voice of Victory provide strong attackers. Ranger-Captain of Eos can fetch important creatures for the deck's strategy, while cards like Galvanic Discharge and Lightning Bolt provide removal and reach. The deck aims to put pressure on the opponent early and close out the game before they have a chance to stabilize.
